fields.headline: Order closing the courthouse and continuing essential functions
fields.findings: The court’s case management system and electronic filing are unavailable because of a cybersecurity incident. The court finds that closing non-essential functions protects the integrity of court records and the safety of staff and the public.
orders: The courthouse is closed to the public for non-essential functions during the effective period.
Non-emergency hearings are continued. The clerk will reset them when systems return and will notify the parties.
The clerk will accept paper filings for essential matters at the security entrance on the south side.
The court administrator will post a status update on the court website and the telephone line every day at noon.
continues: Arraignments and detention hearings for people in custody
fields.deadlines: Filing deadlines that fall in the effective period are extended to the first court day after the order ends.

fields.headline: Emergency docket order for in-custody matters
fields.findings: Speedy trial dates for people held in custody fall within the closure. The court finds that in-custody matters must be heard on an emergency docket.
orders: In-custody arraignments are heard daily at 9:00 a.m. by video from the detention center.
Cases with a speedy trial date in the effective period are set for a status hearing on October 30.
The prosecutor and public defender will send a joint list of affected cases to the court administrator by 5:00 p.m. on October 29.
continues: Video hearings from the detention center
Telephone hearings for emergency protective orders
fields.deadlines: Speedy trial deadlines are addressed case by case at the status hearing.
